_note: Written by scripts/art/ui/reputation_screen.mjs --pieces: do not edit by hand. The Reputation screen (D7, D8, D22, D126, D249) in the window's pixels, 1152 x 648; "at" is a top left corner, and a piece's "at" already counts its shadow. Draw in the order of "order"; text last. Text is drawn by Godot: "at" is the top left of the line (the top is the font's ascent line), "right" its top right, "centre" its top middle. Every place and size here is a setting. The screen is one block: in a bigger window it would be centred (not done).

veil._note: The world behind, done by the game (the death screen's veil shader): each colour goes `grey` of the way to its grey, then `dark` of the way to `tint`, then is darkened towards the corners: times 1 - corners * d^2, d from 0 in the middle to 1 at a corner along each axis (d^2 = dx^2 + dy^2, dx and dy from -1 to 1).

rule._note: A steel rule with a diamond at its left end, drawn from that end (x, y) to the right, "length" long: draw the piece's columns from 0 to inner[0] + length, so that its "inner" lands on (x, y), both rounded to whole pixels. After the title: from "gap" past the title's end to "gap_hint" before the hint's start, at y. After the tales' heading: from "gap" past its end to "end" (an x), at the heading's top + "dy".

cards._note: One card per town (D249), the first at "first", "step" to the right for the next: at most "fits". A town is "known" when it told you anything (D126): Card Known and the town's picture, else Card Unknown, its picture greyed ("Town <name> Unknown") and every text "dim". Every place below is from the card's top left corner. Each row: its sign, its label and its word (UNKNOWN when not known), then Standing and Morality a Scale with the Scale Mark where you stand (v, 0 to 1: the mark's "at" plus scale width times v, rounded; no mark when not known), Fame a bar: "under", then "fill" cut at the value (it reaches x = bar x + inset + (bar width - 2 * inset) * value). The ends of each scale or bar in face "small", colour "dim".

ends._note: the bar's ends sit where the scale's do

told._note: who told you and when (D126); the words are not decided

tales._note: The tales told of you that you heard (D194), oldest first: at most "fits" show (scrolling not done). Each: the Bullet, the tale, and where and when you heard it, right-aligned.

bullet._note: x as is, y from the tale's row

hint.text: Only what you have been told

ask.text: Ask in a town to hear more:  "Tell me more about this person..."
